purpose: Teach: 演歌/林檎/車庫/国宝/大西洋/スリル/毛皮/ビーフ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、演歌のCDをプレゼントしてくれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer gave me an enka CD as a gift.
lines.style: Warm, noticing tone. Gentle smile in the voice. Sharing something small that pleased her. Soft opening, steady pace, slight lift at the end like offering it to Aoi.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューに林檎のタルト加えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's add an apple tart to the new menu, okay?
lines.style: Bright, collaborative energy. Forward-leaning, engaged. The suggestion of someone genuinely excited about something new. Quick, light pace. A little eagerness in the attack.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、車庫に車を入れて来られたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer pulled their car into the garage.
lines.style: Soft, observational tone. Noticing without judgment. Pacing measured and gentle. Trailing slight pause before the end, like turning something over in thought.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、国宝の屏風を見に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer went to see a national treasure screen painting.
lines.style: Quiet, appreciative. Gentle wonder underneath. Slow, deliberate pace. The tone of someone registering something beautiful someone else experienced.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、大西洋を渡る旅をなさるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer is taking a trip across the Atlantic.
lines.style: Soft reverence in the opening. Thoughtful pace. The voice of someone considering a life larger than her own. Slight fade on the verb, like the journey is still unfolding.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ジェットコースターのスリルが好きなんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer really loves the thrill of roller coasters.
lines.style: Gentle, knowing tone. A little smile at the specificity of it. Measured pace. The warmth of understanding what makes someone light up.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、毛皮のコートが暖かそうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer's fur coat looks so warm.
lines.style: Soft, observant. A quiet appreciation for small comforts. Gentle, almost wistful tone. Steady, unhurried pace. The noticing of someone who pays attention to detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、ビーフシチュー作りましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's make beef stew for the new menu.
lines.style: Energized, purposeful opening. Collaborative warmth. Slightly quicker pace than the observational lines. Lightness at the close, like settling on something good together.
